projectTitle: From No Website to a Quotation-Ready Digital Catalogue
summary: A commercial catalogue website that helps buyers discover products and begin a quotation conversation.
challenge: The business had no website or focused landing page, so product discovery and quotation conversations depended on manual sharing.
approach: Evolix combined a clear landing experience, browsable catalogue and quotation-led conversion path instead of building a static company profile.
outcome: A credible online destination where prospective customers can understand the offering and begin quotation enquiries more easily.

testimonial.quote: Evolix gave Nagarwala Trading a professional online presence that we did not have before. Customers can now explore our catalogue through the landing page and send quotation requirements directly. I am very happy with how they understood the idea and turned it into a practical website for our business.
